basics.name: João Alexandre
basics.label: Full-Stack PHP Developer
basics.summary: Full-Stack PHP Developer with {{years}}+ years of professional experience building, maintaining and improving business-oriented web applications. I work end-to-end across PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter), JavaScript, SQL and responsive frontends, from database design and backend APIs to internal tools, automation, testing and deployment. I pick up unfamiliar codebases and technologies quickly, care about reliability and maintainability, and work closely with both technical and business stakeholders.
basics.availability: Open to remote or hybrid Full-Stack PHP, Laravel, Backend and Web Developer roles.

soft.name: Adaptability
soft.description: Quickly learns unfamiliar technologies and codebases, including Python for backend maintenance and C# for Unity game projects.

soft.name: Problem-solving
soft.description: Analyses complex issues, finds the root cause, and ships practical, maintainable fixes.

soft.name: Critical thinking
soft.description: Weighs technical and product trade-offs before choosing an implementation.

soft.name: Ownership
soft.description: Takes features from requirements and design through implementation, testing, documentation and deployment.

soft.name: Communication
soft.description: Explains technical work clearly to developers, business teams, clients and other stakeholders.

highlights: Full-stack development on the acingov web application, delivering both backend and frontend features.
Develop and maintain business-oriented web applications with PHP, CodeIgniter, JavaScript and SQL.
Contribute across backend APIs, database design, frontend interfaces and application support.
Designed and built a full-featured Laravel application for vehicle requisition and internal fleet management.
Automated workflows, centralized operational data and improved asset tracking.
Developed a procurement and purchasing management tool in parallel, focused on scalability, security, maintainability and administrative usability.
Developed and continuously improved web applications used by local councils and public-sector organizations.
Implemented features across the full stack with PHP, Laravel, Yii, JavaScript and SQL.
Improved application performance, reliability, usability and maintainability.
Built new consulting and data-driven web pages with native HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.
Refactored frontend code to improve readability, performance and long-term maintainability.
Implemented search and filtering for data tables, improving how users consult information.
Supported the backend by using Python to run SQL queries and return JSON to frontend components.
Wrote technical documentation for client-facing web pages.
Contributed to an internal Drupal website for EDP to manage and publish corporate news.
Developed and maintained SharePoint pages integrated with Microsoft Teams for an internal virtual community.
Implemented automated test scenarios with Behat and performed manual testing.
Maintained technical documentation in Confluence, created onboarding materials and prepared monthly stakeholder presentations.
Developed and maintained internal web applications used in production environments.
Implemented new features, improved existing software and responded to application incidents.
Configured a Windows Server environment (XAMPP) and improved deployment workflows with Git and SourceTree.
Delivered training sessions and technical presentations for development and business teams.
Erasmus internship building new functionality for internal admin tools and public-facing web platforms.
Worked with Yii, Behat and Twig in an international development team.
Gained hands-on experience with CakePHP, PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS.
Strong performance led to a full-time offer after finishing the course.
Software development, programming, databases and web technologies: Java, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL and SQLite.
Final project: a Unity game, scripted in C#.
